audit_result.proof_trace: The `consentError` returned by `create_user_consent` at L67 is only logged (L74) and never checked; execution unconditionally proceeds to `generateRandomString`+`create_authorization_code` regardless of consent RPC outcome. If consent creation fails (transient DB error, constraint violation), an authorization code is issued without any corresponding consent record, violating the invariant. The intentionality of this omission is refuted by the analogous `codeError` guard at L95-103.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A transient DB failure or timeout during `create_user_consent` causes silent consent-write failure; the server still issues a valid authorization code that the client can exchange for an access token — resulting in an access token issued without recorded user consent.

PROP-stem-system-inv-017.text: User consent must be recorded before authorization code generation.
PROP-stem-system-inv-017.assertion: forall consent: gen_code(consent) => exists(DB.user_consents, consent.user_id, consent.app_id)
